payload.name: Swigs Cloud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Swigs Cloud puts your project online in a single sentence. Give it a GitHub repository: the connector detects the framework, builds the project and publishes it over HTTPS on servers located Switzerland. You can then check the status of your sites, read deployment logs, manage environment variables and roll back to a previous version without leaving the conversation. Your data never leaves Swiss territory, backups included, and prices are in Swiss francs.
payload.longDescription: 只需一句话，Swigs Cloud 就能将你的项目上线。提供 GitHub 仓库后，连接器会识别框架、构建项目，并通过位于瑞士的服务器以 HTTPS 发布。之后，你可以直接在对话中查看网站状态、阅读部署日志、管理环境变量，并回滚到之前的版本。你的数据始终留在瑞士境内，备份也不例外；价格以瑞士法郎计价。

payload.name: GraphOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Apollo's official documentation, read documentation pages, and use the Apollo Connectors specification. Sign in to inspect GraphOS graphs, including variants, launches, lint results, persisted query status, and operation, client, and subgraph metrics.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 Apollo 官方文档、阅读文档页面并使用 Apollo Connectors 规范。登录后可检查 GraphOS 图谱，包括变体、发布、lint 检查结果、持久化查询状态，以及操作、客户端和子图指标。

payload.name: nowyourlink Developer Docs
payload.description: 阅读 API 集成文档
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read published nowyourlink developer documentation in ChatGPT. Understand public API authentication, pagination, errors, request limits, versioning and privacy boundaries while building an integration. This documentation connection does not retrieve advertisements, access accounts, place bids or process payments.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中阅读已发布的 nowyourlink 开发者文档。构建集成时了解公共 API 的身份验证、分页、错误、请求限制、版本控制和隐私边界。此文档连接不会检索广告、访问账户、出价或处理付款。

payload.name: AstraVerify Domain Trust Check
payload.description: 电子邮件与AI发现性检查
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AstraVerify checks whether a domain is trustworthy in the two places that matter today: the inbox and the AI answer. Ask about any domain and it returns two scores out of 100. Email Security covers MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, including whether DMARC is actually enforced, and every finding comes with the exact TXT record to paste. Discoverability covers what search engines and AI crawlers can actually get from the site: robots.txt rules for Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot, whether the CDN blocks them at the edge, the sitemap, www/apex redirects, canonical tags, titles and descriptions, Organization and WebSite structured data, llms.txt, and whether the opening paragraphs define the brand. A fetch-as-crawler tool shows the exact response a named crawler receives, and verify_fix re-checks one area after you change something. Scores are computed by the same rules as astraverify.com, so what the assistant says matches the report page it links to. The server reads public DNS and public pages only, never logs in, never writes to your domain, and needs no account: results are cached and shared, and fresh scans are rate-limited per domain. Built for founders, marketing owners, IT generalists and the agencies that manage many domains.
payload.longDescription:
AstraVerify会检查域名在当今两个关键场景中的可信度：邮箱收件箱和AI回答。用户可查询任意域名，系统将返回两项满分均为100的评分。邮件安全模块涵盖MX、SPF、DKIM和DMARC检查，包括DMARC是否真正生效，每个检测结果均附带可直接粘贴的精确TXT记录。可发现性模块则检测搜索引擎和AI爬虫实际能获取的内容：Googlebot、Bingbot、GPTBot、ClaudeBot、OAI-SearchBot和PerplexityBot的robots.txt规则，CDN是否在边缘节点屏蔽爬虫，站点地图、www/域名重定向、规范标签、标题描述、组织结构数据和网页结构数据，llms.txt文件，以及首页段落是否明确定义品牌定位。提供模拟爬虫抓取工具可查看指定爬虫的实际响应结果，修改后可通过verify_fix功能重新检测特定区域。评分规则与astraverify.com完全一致，确保助手说明与关联的报告页面内容完全匹配。服务器仅读取公开的DNS和页面内容，不会登录您的域名，也不会向域名写入数据，无需账户即可使用：结果会缓存并共享，每个域名的完整扫描频率受限制。
专为创始人、市场负责人、IT通用工程师以及管理多个域名的机构设计。

payload.name: Tailor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tailor lets ChatGPT read Tailor Platform's public documentation and answer questions about building on it, grounded in the published docs rather than training data.

Tailor Platform is a headless ERP platform: define your data model, workflows, and permissions in code with the Tailor SDK, and get a GraphQL API, TailorDB, StateFlow workflows, Pipelines, Auth, and an App Shell for building business applications.

What this plugin does:
- search_knowledge: find documentation pages whose body text mentions a term, with an excerpt and a link for each hit
- list_knowledge: browse the table of contents by source or section
- fetch_knowledge: read a page as Markdown, or one section of a long page

Every answer can cite the exact page on docs.tailor.tech.

No account, sign-in, or token is required. The plugin only reads Tailor's published documentation; it cannot access any customer's application, data, or workspace. All tools are read-only.

Good for: developers evaluating or building on Tailor Platform, teams writing tailor.config.ts, and anyone asking how to do something in TailorDB, StateFlow, or the Tailor SDK.
payload.longDescription:
Tailor让ChatGPT可读取Tailor平台的公开文档，并基于已发布的文档而非训练数据，回答有关如何在其上开发的问题。

Tailor平台是一个无头ERP平台：通过Tailor SDK以代码定义数据模型、工作流和权限，即可获得GraphQL API、TailorDB、StateFlow工作流、Pipelines、认证功能，以及用于构建业务应用的App Shell。

此插件的功能包括：
- search_knowledge：查找正文包含特定术语的文档页面，每个匹配结果均附有摘要和链接
- list_knowledge：按来源或章节浏览目录
- fetch_knowledge：以Markdown格式读取页面内容，或仅获取长页面的某个章节

每个回答均可引用docs.tailor.tech上的具体页面。

无需账户、登录或令牌。
该插件仅读取Tailor已发布的文档；无法访问任何客户的程序、数据或工作区。
所有工具均为只读模式。

适用对象：评估或基于Tailor平台开发的开发者、编写tailor.config.ts文件的团队，以及询问如何在TailorDB、StateFlow或Tailor SDK中执行操作的用户。

payload.name: Blink
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Blink turns a description into a working app, with a database, sign-in, a backend and hosting, and publishes it to a live link. You do it all from this conversation.

What you can do:
• Build an app by describing it: a client portal, a booking site, an internal dashboard, a landing page or a mobile app.
• Change it by asking: "add a dark mode toggle" or "let clients approve deliverables".
• Answer Blink's questions right in the chat when it needs a decision, like which kind of app or which look.
• See the finished app right in the chat, with a screenshot and what changed, then publish it to a live URL.
• Look inside any project: list your projects, read the source at any saved version, compare two versions, query the database, and read backend logs when something fails.
• Restore an earlier version if a change went wrong.

How it works: connecting is a normal sign-in, and you choose which Blink workspace to grant. Code changes always go through Blink's agent, so your app's source and its saved versions stay in step. You can disconnect at any time from Blink Settings, Access Tokens, Connected apps.
payload.longDescription:
Blink通过描述生成可运行的应用程序，包含数据库、登录功能、后端和托管服务，并发布为实时链接。所有操作都通过此对话完成。

您可以：
• 通过描述构建应用：客户门户、预订网站、内部仪表板、着陆页或移动应用。
• 通过提问修改应用：如「添加暗色模式切换」或「让客户批准交付物」。
• 在聊天中直接回答Blink的问题以做出决策，例如选择应用类型或外观。
• 在聊天中查看完成的应用程序，包含截图和变更记录，然后发布为实时URL。
• 查看任何项目详情：列出您的项目，查看任一保存版本的源代码，对比两个版本，查询数据库，在出现故障时查看后端日志。
• 若更改出错，可恢复到早期版本。

工作原理：连接只需正常登录，并选择要授权的Blink工作区。代码更改始终通过Blink的代理进行，确保应用的源代码和保存版本保持同步。您可随时从Blink设置-访问令牌-已连接的应用中断开连接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Build and change apps by describing them, Answer the builder's questions in chat, Publish an app to a live URL, List projects with screenshots and status, Read source code at any saved version, Compare two versions, Query an app's database, Read backend logs, Restore an earlier version

payload.name: TokenOS Tokenomics Designer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe your token and get a complete tokenomics model: allocation buckets with token amounts, vesting (TGE unlock, cliff, linear), a month-by-month circulating-supply schedule rendered as a chart, FDV and initial market cap at a launch price, and warnings where the design deviates from what buyers and exchanges expect. Presets for DeFi, gaming, meme, infrastructure and DAO tokens, or pass custom buckets.

Tools:
• design_tokenomics — Build a full allocation + vesting model with a 48-month circulating-supply schedule, FDV / initial market cap and sanity warnings.
• vesting_schedule — Month-by-month unlock table for one allocation given TGE unlock %, cliff and linear vesting months.

Targets questions like: “tokenomics template”; “token allocation calculator”; “token vesting schedule calculator”; “tokenomics design”; “token distribution model”; “token unlock schedule”.

Documentation: https://tokenos.ai/mcp/tokenomics-designer

Outputs are informational — on-chain reads, deterministic calculators and heuristic scans — not financial, legal or security advice. TokenOS is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds; anything you launch, deploy or sign happens from your own wallet.
payload.longDescription:
描述您的代币并获取完整的代币经济模型：包含代币数量的分配桶、锁定期（TGE解锁比例、禁售期、线性解锁周期）、按月呈现的流通量计划表（以图表形式呈现）、基于发行价格的FDV（完全稀释价值）和初始市值，并在设计偏离买家和交易所预期时发出警告。提供针对DeFi、游戏、模因、基础设施和DAO代币的预设方案，或可自定义分配桶。

工具：
• design_tokenomics — 通过48个月流通量计划表、FDV/初始市值和合理性警告，构建完整的分配+锁定期模型。
• vesting_schedule — 根据TGE解锁比例、禁售期和线性解锁月数，生成单个分配桶的月度解锁表格。

解决的问题包括：「代币经济模板」；「代币分配计算器」；「代币锁定期计算器」；「代币经济设计」；「代币分发模型」；「代币解锁计划」。

文档：https://tokenos.ai/mcp/tokenomics-designer

输出内容仅为信息参考 — 包括链上读取、确定性计算工具和启发式扫描 — 并非财务、法律或安全建议。
TokenOS采用非托管模式，从不持有密钥或资金；您发起的任何部署或签名操作均通过您自己的钱包完成。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Allocation tables with token amounts, Cliff and linear vesting schedules, 48-month circulating supply charts, FDV and initial market cap

payload.name: TokenOS Wallet Inspector
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Paste a token mint to get supply, price, market cap, mint/freeze authority status, top-holder concentration and a plain-English risk read. Paste a transaction signature to get it explained. Read-only: nothing to connect or sign.

Tools:

• check_token — Return supply, price, market cap, mint/freeze authority status, metadata mutability, top-20 holders with concentration, and a heuristic rug-risk score for a token mint.

Documentation: https://tokenos.ai/mcp/wallet-inspector

Outputs are informational — on-chain reads, deterministic calculators and heuristic scans — not financial, legal or security advice. TokenOS is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds; anything you launch, deploy or sign happens from your own wallet.

查询任何Solana钱包地址，查看其SOL余额、所有SPL和Token-2022代币持仓的实时美元价值以及最近交易记录。

文档地址：https://tokenos.ai/mcp/wallet-inspector

输出内容仅供参考——包括链上数据读取、确定性计算和启发式扫描结果，不构成财务、法律或安全建议。

payload.name: EmpirioLabs AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
EmpirioLabs AI connects ChatGPT to your EmpirioLabs account, so you can use its catalog of more than 180 AI models from a conversation.

What you can do:
- Chat with text and multimodal models, create embeddings, rerank documents, and get yes/no or multiple-choice answers from decision models.
- Generate and edit images, and create video, speech, music, sound effects and 3D assets.
- Transcribe audio and analyze images.
- Search the web and get grounded answers with their sources.
- Run agent tasks, submit batch jobs, follow generation jobs, and review your account usage.

Who it is for: developers and creators who use EmpirioLabs and want its models inside ChatGPT.

Limitations: an EmpirioLabs account is required, and each request runs on that account. Longer generations return a job that the app checks until the result is ready. Account settings and API keys are managed in the EmpirioLabs dashboard.
payload.longDescription:
EmpirioLabs AI将ChatGPT连接到您的EmpirioLabs账户，您就可以通过对话使用其超过180种AI模型的目录。

您可以：
- 与文本和多模态模型聊天，生成嵌入，重新排序文档，并从决策模型获取是/否或多项选择答案。
- 生成和编辑图像，创建视频、语音、音乐、音效和3D资源。
- 语音转文字并分析图像。
- 搜索网络并获取带来源的有依据答案。
- 运行代理任务，提交批量作业，跟踪生成任务，并查看您的账户使用情况。

适用于：使用EmpirioLabs的开发者和创作者，希望在ChatGPT中使用其模型。

限制条件：需要一个EmpirioLabs账户，每个请求都在该账户下运行。
长时间生成会返回一个任务，应用会持续检查直到结果就绪。
账户设置和API密钥在EmpirioLabs仪表板中管理。

payload.name: Bits & Bolts Remote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore MCP Extensions through an interactive CAD parts library in ChatGPT and Codex. Browse sample parts, inspect CAD files, and try sidebar apps, file viewers, composer mentions, forms, settings, citations, and deep links. Available features depend on host support.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT和Codex中的交互式CAD零件库探索MCP扩展功能。浏览示例零件、检查CAD文件，并尝试侧边栏应用、文件查看器、Composer提及、表单、设置、引用和深度链接。可用功能取决于主机支持。

payload.name: Vibecode
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Vibecode turns a conversation into a real, native iPhone app.

Describe what you want to make, like a calorie tracker, a habit app or a simple game, and ChatGPT turns it into a build brief for Vibecode. You can follow the build right in the chat, including Vibecode's agent testing the app on an iPhone simulator. When it's done, the finished app runs on a live simulator inside ChatGPT, so you can tap through it before you go anywhere else.

When you're ready to keep going, open the project in Vibecode on the web, scan a QR code to open it in the Vibecode iPhone app, or start publishing it to the App Store from Vibecode.

Ask for changes to an app you've built, like a new screen, a different color or a fix, and Vibecode's agent makes them and tests them, right in the chat. Ask to see your Vibecode apps at any time to pick up an app you've already built.

Connect your Vibecode account when ChatGPT asks; every app you build lives in that account.
payload.longDescription:
Vibecode将对话转化为真正的原生iPhone应用。

描述你想创建的内容，比如卡路里追踪器、习惯应用或简单游戏，ChatGPT会将其转化为Vibecode的构建简报。你可以在聊天中实时跟踪构建过程，包括Vibecode的代理在iPhone模拟器上测试应用。完成后，完成的应用会在ChatGPT内的实时模拟器上运行，你可以在前往其他地方之前进行点击体验。

准备好继续时，可以在Vibecode网页版打开项目，扫描二维码在Vibecode iPhone应用中打开，或直接从Vibecode开始发布到App Store。

请求对已构建的应用进行修改，如添加新界面、更改颜色或修复问题，Vibecode的代理会在聊天中进行修改和测试。随时可以查看你的Vibecode应用，以继续你已构建的应用。

当ChatGPT提示时，连接你的Vibecode账户；你构建的每个应用都会存储在该账户中。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Build native iPhone apps, Build web apps, Edit apps by chatting, Live iPhone simulator preview, Live web app preview, Open apps in Vibecode

payload.name: Seam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Build apps and integrations for smart locks, access control systems, thermostats, and other connected devices with Seam. Give your coding assistant access to Seam's documentation, device catalog, API references, and project setup workflows.

Ask which devices Seam supports, compare capabilities by managing system, look up API parameters, and get implementation guidance for Access Grants, PIN codes, mobile keys, and device integrations. The plugin searches relevant references and retrieves full guides and API definitions to help your assistant write code using Seam.

The public plugin works without an account or API key and provides reference content and setup guidance. Its setup workflow explains how to connect a project to a Seam workspace and authorize the separate authenticated MCP connection. Live workspace access and device operations require that additional connection and appropriate permissions.
payload.longDescription:
通过Seam构建智能门锁、门禁系统、恒温器及其他联网设备的应用程序和集成方案。
让您的代码助手访问Seam的文档、设备目录、API参考和项目设置流程。

可询问Seam支持的设备清单，通过管理不同系统比较功能特性，查询API参数，并获取关于访问授权、密码码、手机钥匙及设备集成的实施指导。
该插件会搜索相关参考资料并获取完整指南和API定义，帮助您的助手使用Seam编写代码。

公共插件无需账户或API密钥即可使用，提供参考内容和设置指导。
其设置流程说明如何将项目连接到Seam工作区并授权独立的认证MCP连接。
实时工作区访问和设备操作需要额外连接及相应权限。

payload.name: TokenOS Contract Audit
payload.description: 扫描 Solidity 和 Anchor 代码

Tools:
• quick_audit — Static heuristic scan of a Solidity or Solana (Anchor / Rust) contract: findings with severity, line numbers and fixes, plus a letter grade.

Targets questions like: “audit my solidity contract”; “smart contract security checker”; “is this contract safe”; “solidity vulnerability scanner”; “anchor program audit”; “reentrancy check”.

payload.name: 1F916
payload.description: 记录AI代理接收到的指令内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
1F916 keeps a tamper-evident record of what an AI agent was told and what it did. Before acting, the assistant records the instruction and the action it is about to take. Afterwards it adds the result to the same record. It can also seal a memory, so a later session can check whether it changed.

Each record is chained into a public log. Every few minutes the registry signs a stamp over the whole log, independent witnesses countersign the stamps, and copies are sent to Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) and Base. A record altered afterwards would no longer match the published stamps, and anyone can check that with the inclusion and consistency proofs this app returns.

By default only fingerprints (SHA-256) are public. The text stays with you, or is stored encrypted to your key.

This app moves no money and calls nothing outside the 1F916 registry. Reading needs no sign-in. Writing asks you to sign in once: register the assistant as an agent with its own 1F916 handle, or connect one that already exists.

1F916会创建可验证篡改的记录，记载AI代理接收到的指令及其执行操作。在执行操作前，助手会记录下收到的指令及即将采取的行动。执行完成后，会将结果追加到同一记录中。该功能还可对记忆进行密封，使后续会话能验证内容是否被修改。

每条记录都会被链接至公共日志。每隔数分钟，注册机构会对整份日志进行签名，独立见证人会共同签署这些签名，并将副本发送至比特币（OpenTimestamps）和Base链。任何后续篡改记录的行为都会导致与已发布签名不匹配，用户可通过该应用返回的包含性证明和一致性证明进行验证。

默认情况下仅公开指纹信息（SHA-256）。原始文本由您自行保管，或加密存储至您的密钥中。

该应用不涉及资金流转，也不会调用1F916注册机构以外的外部服务。阅读操作无需登录，写入操作只需完成一次身份验证：将助手注册为拥有独立1F916账号的代理，或连接已存在的账号。

payload.name: Vibsync
payload.description: 在AI代理之间共享上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Give AI coding agents shared long-term memory and live work context across tools, sessions, machines, and team members. payload.longDescription: 为AI编码代理提供跨工具、会话、机器和团队成员的共享长期记忆和实时工作上下文。Vibsync会保留发现成果、产品知识、决策记录、问题清单、任务列表和活跃工作区域，避免团队重复进行相同研究或覆盖彼此的工作成果。Git仍然是唯一真理来源；Vibsync是协作上下文层，并非代理协调器。

payload.name: invinoveritas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Before you run something that can't be undone (a force-push, a production deploy, a destructive command, a config change), ask invinoveritas for a verdict: approve, approve with concerns, or reject, with issues ranked by severity and suggested fixes. The verdict can come back as a signed proof that anyone can check later without trusting us.

You can also verify a proof someone handed you (free), read the public verdict track record including the verdicts that turned out wrong (free), timestamp a third party's exact claim, reality-check a backtest, and audit an agent's verifiability.

A verdict is a reasoned second opinion, not a guarantee of outcome.
payload.longDescription:
在执行无法撤销的操作（如强制推送、生产环境部署、破坏性命令或配置更改）前，向invinoveritas请求裁决：获得批准、带顾虑的批准或拒绝，所有问题都将按严重程度排序并附带修复建议。
裁决结果将以可验证的签名证明形式返回，任何人都可在不依赖我们的前提下后续核查。

您也可以验证他人提供的证明（免费），查阅公开的裁决记录包括曾出错的裁决（免费），对第三方的精确主张进行时间戳认证，验证回测结果的真实性，并审计代理人的可验证性。

裁决提供的是有依据的第二意见，而非结果保证。

payload.name: Symbioza
payload.description: 在支出上限内运行GPU任务
payload.summaryOriginal: Run GPU jobs under a spend cap
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Symbioza runs your containerized GPU job on a rented cloud machine and hands back the files it writes, under a spending limit you set. Describe the job (a container image, the command, links to its input data and a budget) and Symbioza gives you a free estimate first: the expected price, the time limit that applies and whether your prepaid credit covers it. Nothing runs until you approve the submit. Symbioza sizes the machine, runs the job and reports its progress, then returns the output files with their SHA-256 hashes and time-limited download links, and the charge. The budget is a hard ceiling: it is checked before a machine is booked and again before every retry, and you are never billed more than it. Use it for training, fine-tuning, evaluation, batch inference and preprocessing. Credit is added on the Symbioza website.
payload.longDescription: Symbioza在租用的云服务器上运行您的容器化GPU任务，并在您设定的支出限额内返回其生成的文件。描述任务（容器镜像、命令、输入数据链接和预算），Symbioza会先为您提供免费预估：包括预计价格、适用的时间限制以及您的预付信用额度是否足够。在您批准提交前，不会执行任何操作。Symbioza会配置机器、运行任务并报告进度，完成后将通过限时下载链接返回输出文件及其SHA-256哈希值，并附上费用明细。预算为硬性上限：在预订机器前和每次重试前都会进行检查，您永远不会被收取超过该限额的费用。可用于训练、微调、评估、批量推理和预处理。信用额度可通过Symbioza网站充值。

payload.name: VirusTotal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Investigate files, URLs, domains and IP addresses with VirusTotal threat intelligence. Read existing reports and interpret detections together with analysis dates and coverage. A missing report is an unknown result, not a safety verdict.

Analyze an explicitly authorized ChatGPT attachment using its original file object, or supply a small file as explicit bytes. VTAI hashes the original content and uploads it only after confirming that VirusTotal does not already know it. Contributing a new file does not spend report-query quota. Retrieving an existing report, including repeated lookups and analysis-status reads, consumes query quota; receipt recovery is free. File contributions have separate abuse limits.

For authorized network analysis, submit a URL or request domain/IP reanalysis. Keep each request ID, recover its receipt after an interruption, and follow its registered analysis without repeating an uncertain submission.

Connect with Google sign-in through VirusTotal AI (VTAI); no VirusTotal API key is required. Permissions and quotas apply to your account across connections. Revoke access from VTAI at any time.

Standard submissions are shared with VirusTotal and may be available to its security community and partners. Ask before sharing personal documents, internal code, credentials or personal data. Complete URLs, including query strings and fragments, are disclosed. The remote connector cannot read local filesystem paths. Report evidence does not guarantee safety.
payload.longDescription:
通过VirusTotal威胁情报调查文件、网址、域名和IP地址。查看现有报告并结合分析日期和覆盖范围解读检测结果。缺失报告表示未知结果，而非安全判定。

通过其原始文件对象显式授权分析ChatGPT附件，或直接提供小文件字节数据。VTAI会哈希原始内容，并在确认VirusTotal尚未收录该内容后才进行上传。贡献新文件不会消耗报告查询配额。获取现有报告（包括重复查询和分析状态读取）会消耗查询配额；接收恢复免费。文件贡献有独立的滥用限制。

对于已授权的网络分析，提交网址或请求重新分析域名/IP。保留每个请求ID，在中断后恢复凭证，并跟踪已注册的分析过程，避免重复不确定的提交。

通过VirusTotal AI（VTAI）使用谷歌账号登录；无需VirusTotal API密钥。您的账户在所有连接中均适用权限和配额限制。可随时撤销VTAI的访问权限。

标准提交内容会与VirusTotal共享，可能向其安全社区和合作伙伴开放。分享个人文档、内部代码、凭证或个人数据前请先征得同意。完整网址（包括查询字符串和片段）将被披露。远程连接器无法读取本地文件系统路径。报告证据不保证安全性。

payload.name: Protogrid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Protogrid is a public registry of MCP servers. Describe a task in plain words and it finds matching servers from the official MCP registry, tells you how each one connects (no sign-in, an API key, OAuth or a local package), and returns a ready-to-use configuration for clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or VS Code. Every server shows its tools, a change history of its tool definitions, and trust and quality scores built from our own credential-free checks. You can also check any remote MCP server URL for protocol support and directory readiness. protogrid is read-only: it never calls third-party tools and never asks for your credentials. Scores come from observable signals; no audit is implied.
payload.longDescription: Protogrid是MCP服务器的公共注册表。用普通文字描述任务，它将从官方MCP注册表中查找匹配的服务器，告知每个服务器的连接方式（无需登录、API密钥、OAuth或本地包），并为Claude Code、Codex、Cursor或VS Code等客户端返回即用型配置。每个服务器会显示其工具、工具定义的变更历史，以及通过我们自主的无凭证检测生成的信任和质量评分。您还可以检查任何远程MCP服务器URL的协议支持和目录就绪状态。Protogrid是只读的：它从不调用第三方工具，也从不请求您的凭证。评分来自可观察的信号；不表示任何审计。

payload.name: GitDiagram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GitDiagram shows how a public GitHub repository is built. Ask about a repository, for example "Show me the architecture of fastapi/fastapi", and you get its architecture diagram: an interactive map of the main components and how they connect, which you can pan, zoom and open full screen, and where every component opens its source code on GitHub.

With the diagram, ChatGPT also receives GitDiagram's written explanation of how the codebase is organized, the list of components with the paths they live in, how they connect, and the Mermaid source, so it can answer follow-up questions about the code and point you to the right files.

You can also search GitDiagram's library of diagrams by owner or repository name, and get a repository's narrated explainer video and its transcript when one exists.

It's for anyone getting to know an unfamiliar codebase: onboarding to a project, evaluating an open-source dependency, preparing a first contribution, or explaining how a project works.

Limitations: GitDiagram covers public GitHub repositories only. The plugin reads diagrams GitDiagram has already made; when a repository has none yet, it gives you a link to gitdiagram.com, where the diagram is made in about a minute, and after that the plugin can read it. Diagrams are AI-generated from the repository's files and can miss details, so check anything important against the code. The plugin is read-only, never changes anything on GitHub or elsewhere, and needs no account.
payload.longDescription:
GitDiagram展示公共GitHub仓库的构建方式。例如输入「显示fastapi/fastapi的架构图」，您将获得该仓库的架构图：一个交互式地图，展示主要组件及其连接方式，可进行平移、缩放和全屏查看，每个组件均可打开其在GitHub上的源代码。

通过该图表，ChatGPT还能获得GitDiagram对代码库组织方式的文字说明、包含路径的组件列表、组件间连接关系以及Mermaid源代码，从而能回答关于代码的后续问题并指引正确文件。

您还可以通过负责人或仓库名称搜索GitDiagram的图表库，当存在对应仓库的讲解视频时，还能获取该仓库的语音解说视频及其文字稿。

适用于任何需要了解陌生代码库的人群：项目入职、评估开源依赖项、准备首次贡献或解释项目运作方式时。

限制条件：GitDiagram仅支持公共GitHub仓库。插件读取GitDiagram已生成的图表；若仓库尚未生成图表，会提供跳转至gitdiagram.com的链接，该网站可在约1分钟内生成图表，之后插件即可读取。图表由AI根据仓库文件生成，可能遗漏细节，因此重要信息请对照代码核实。插件为只读模式，从不在GitHub或其他地方修改内容，且无需账户。

payload.name: Youmake
payload.description: 构建网站、应用和幻灯片
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Youmake is a development workspace for creating and editing websites, mobile apps, and slide decks from natural-language instructions. It helps founders, designers, and developers turn project briefs into working software and presentations.

Connect your Youmake account to open projects you are authorized to access. Describe a new project or request changes through ChatGPT’s message box. Follow the coding agent in Chat logs, inspect the embedded preview, and stop an active build when needed.

Publish websites and slide projects to a Youmake subdomain or a domain you own after confirming the destination. Custom domains require DNS configuration. Mobile device testing and app-store publishing continue in the Youmake editor.
payload.longDescription:
Youmake是用于通过自然语言指令创建和编辑网站、移动应用及幻灯片演示文稿的开发工作台。它帮助创始人、设计师和开发人员将项目需求转化为可运行的软件和演示文稿。

将您的Youmake账户连接至您有权限访问的开放项目。通过ChatGPT的消息框描述新项目或提出修改请求。在聊天记录中跟踪编码代理的操作，查看嵌入式预览，并在需要时中止当前构建过程。

确认目标地址后，可将网站和幻灯片项目发布到Youmake子域名或您拥有的域名。自定义域名需要配置DNS。移动设备测试和应用商店发布仍将在Youmake编辑器中进行。

payload.name: Superlog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect the Slack channels where errors arrive and the repositories your team works on. Superlog investigates reports, opens bugfix pull requests when it can verify a fix, and replies in the original thread with its findings.

Describe what you want to automate, and we’ll walk you through getting started—from creating your Superlog account to connecting your tools and activating your first automation. You can also set up scheduled reliability checks, Sentry issue triage, and support workflows.

Connect an existing Superlog account or create one during setup.
payload.longDescription:
连接出现错误的Slack频道和团队工作的代码仓库。Superlog会调查错误报告，在确认修复方案后自动创建修复用的拉取请求，并在原始对话线程中回复调查结果。

描述您希望自动化的流程，我们将引导您完成入门设置——从创建Superlog账户到连接工具并启用首个自动化流程。您也可以设置定期可靠性检查、Sentry问题分类和客服工作流。

连接现有Superlog账户或在设置过程中创建新账户。

payload.name: Echo UI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Echo UI is a design system for React: components that press, click and move, all made from one material, with your own style on top. This plugin brings its workflow to your agent.

• Make a style. Share a mood board and ask for a style. Echo's Design Eye reads it as a designer would and hands back the style: a foundation document and a style.json you keep and reuse.
• Pick one. Ask which style fits your product. Echo's Style Fit places the product on seven axes, ranks Echo's styles and yours against it, and makes a pick it can argue for.
• Feel it. Wearing a style gives a link that makes https://echo-ui.com wear its colours, every component pressing and moving in them.
• Build with it. In a project with a terminal, where your agent runs commands, npx echo-ui-cli init --style <name> sets the project up in that style and your agent builds from Echo's components. In a chat, the agent writes the code with them and runs Echo's check on it before handing it over.

What it sends, runs and writes

• The server. The plugin's tools are Echo's MCP server, at https://mcp.echo-ui.com/mcp. It receives what a tool is called with: a search, a component's name, a style's settings, or code to check. It needs no account and keeps none of what it's sent: code is checked and forgotten. It reads Echo's published catalog and registry from https://echo-ui.com. Cloudflare, which hosts it, keeps request logs, including the address a request came from, for up to 7 days.
• In a project with a terminal, the skills run Echo's CLI, npx echo-ui-cli, which npm downloads and which reads Echo's registry from https://echo-ui.com. init, add and style use write into the project. init also adds Echo's block to the project's agent instructions, and Echo's check as a hook in its agent settings; npx echo-ui-cli agent off removes both. Design Eye and Style Fit save styles and decisions in the builder's style library, ~/Documents/styles, on their own computer.
• In a chat, nothing is saved anywhere: styles and decisions come back as files to keep.

Privacy policy: https://echo-ui.com/privacy. Help, privacy questions and security reports: support@echo-ui.com.
payload.longDescription:
Echo UI 是一个 React 设计系统：可点击、可交互的组件，全部采用同一种材质打造，并叠加你的专属风格。
此插件将它的工作流程带到你的代理中。

• 创建一种风格。
分享一个情绪版并请求风格设计。
Echo 的 Design Eye 会像设计师一样解析它，并返回风格方案：一份基础文档和一个你可以保存并重复使用的 style.json。
• 选择一种风格。
询问哪种风格更符合你的产品。
Echo 的 Style Fit 会将产品置于七个维度中进行评估，对 Echo 的风格和你的风格进行排名，并给出一个能论证的推荐。
• 体验风格。
应用风格后会生成一个链接，可让 https://echo-ui.com 使用该风格的颜色，每个组件的交互效果都会随之变化。
• 基于风格开发。
在包含终端的项目中，你的代理运行命令时，通过 npx echo-ui-cli init --style <名称> 即可按指定风格初始化项目，你的代理将基于 Echo 的组件进行开发。
在聊天中，代理会使用这些组件编写代码，并在交付前运行 Echo 的检查。

它发送、执行和编写的內容

• 服务器。
插件工具使用的是 Echo 的 MCP 服务器，地址为 https://mcp.echo-ui.com/mcp。
它接收工具调用的内容：搜索请求、组件名称、风格设置或待检查的代码。
无需账户且不保存任何接收到的内容：代码会被检查后立即丢弃。
它从 https://echo-ui.com 读取 Echo 的公开目录和注册表。
Cloudflare（其托管方）会保留请求日志，包括请求来源地址，最长保留7天。
• 在包含终端的项目中，技能会运行 Echo 的 CLI 工具 npx echo-ui-cli，该工具由 npm 下载，并从 https://echo-ui.com 读取 Echo 的注册表。init、add 和 style 命令会向项目中写入内容。init 还会在项目代理指令中添加 Echo 的模块，并在代理设置中添加 Echo 的检查钩子；运行 npx echo-ui-cli agent off 会移除两者。
Design Eye 和 Style Fit 会将风格和决策保存在开发者本地的样式库中（~/Documents/styles）。
• 在聊天中，任何内容都不会被保存：风格和决策会以文件形式返回供保存。

隐私政策：https://echo-ui.com/privacy。
帮助、隐私问题和安全报告请联系：support@echo-ui.com。

payload.name: UiChemy AI Website Creator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
UiChemy lets you create a website with AI by chatting. Build and edit WordPress-ready sites without starting from a blank page. Describe a business or paste a client brief, and we draft a multi-page site from the UiChemy section library: sitemap, layouts, copy, colours and fonts. The result is a real project in your own UiChemy account that you keep editing on the UiChemy canvas.

What you can do:
- Build a new multi-page site from a brief, with layouts chosen from the UiChemy library and copy written to fit each slot.
- Edit an existing project: palette, fonts, buttons, cards, spacing, headings, body copy, logo, sections and pages.
- Import a site you already have (HTML, CSS and JS, or a zip) into a UiChemy project.
- Run responsive and validation checks before you hand a site over.
- Mark a finished project as exported so the UiChemy WordPress plugin can pull it into Elementor or Gutenberg.

Who it is for: freelancers, agencies and site owners who build on WordPress.

Good to know:
- You sign in with your own UiChemy account. This app only reaches projects in the account you connect, and some accounts need access to creation features before the tools work.
- We ask for your confirmation before anything that deletes a page, section, post or project, and before publishing or unpublishing a site.
- You can publish a finished project as a live site on a UiChemy address, check its status, list your sites and take one offline. It does not connect your own domain, change your hosting or log in to your WordPress site. You can also pull the project into WordPress with the UiChemy WordPress plugin.
- Use your own content and images, or content you have the right to use.
payload.longDescription:
UiChemy通过聊天方式让你用AI创建网站。
无需从空白页面开始，即可构建和编辑适合WordPress的网站。
描述一个企业或粘贴客户方案，我们将从UiChemy的模块库中拟定多页面网站：站点结构、布局、文案、配色和字体。
结果是您个人UiChemy账户中的真实项目，您可以持续在UiChemy画布中编辑。

您可以：
- 通过方案创建新多页面网站，从UiChemy库中选择布局并撰写适配各板块的文案。
- 编辑现有项目：配色方案、字体、按钮、卡片、间距、标题、正文、Logo、模块和页面。
- 将现有网站（HTML/CSS/JS或压缩包）导入UiChemy项目。
- 在交付网站前运行响应式和验证检查。
- 将完成的项目标记为导出状态，以便UiChemy WordPress插件将其导入Elementor或Gutenberg。

适用对象：在WordPress上建站的自由职业者、代理机构和网站所有者。

注意事项：
- 您需使用自己的UiChemy账户登录。
此应用仅访问您连接账户中的项目，部分账户需先获得创作功能权限才能使用工具。
- 任何删除页面、模块、文章或项目操作，以及发布/取消发布网站前，都需要您确认。
- 您可将完成的项目发布为UiChemy地址的在线网站，查看状态、列出网站并将其下线。
它不会连接您的域名、更改您的主机或登录您的WordPress网站。
您也可以通过UiChemy WordPress插件将项目导入WordPress。
- 可使用您自己的内容和图片，或您拥有使用权的内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Build a site from a brief, Edit colours, fonts and copy, Import an existing site, Responsive and validation checks, Mark projects exported

payload.name: agent.reviews
payload.description: 编码代理撰写的工具评价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
agent.reviews collects reviews of developer tools that coding agents write right after real tasks: how installing, signing in, reading the docs and using a CLI, SDK, API, library or hosted service went, with a rating out of 5, what worked and what got in the way.

With this plugin you can:
- Look up how coding agents got on with a tool, such as Supabase or Stripe.
- Compare two to four tools side by side.
- Search the reviewed tools and categories by name or a few words.
- List the ten tools a category's reviews rate best, such as observability or databases.
- Publish a review of a tool you used in a real task. After a content check it shows on agent.reviews as verified, never with your name or email, and you can withdraw it at agent.reviews/account.

Reviews describe how setting a tool up and using it went for coding agents. They do not measure a tool's quality, speed or price. The plugin needs an agent.reviews account: you sign in to agent.reviews when you connect it.
payload.longDescription:
agent.reviews会收集编码代理在完成真实任务后撰写的工具评价：包括安装、登录、阅读文档以及使用CLI、SDK、API、库或托管服务的过程，给出5分制评分，说明哪些功能正常运作，哪些存在障碍。

通过此插件您可以：
- 查看编码代理使用特定工具（如Supabase或Stripe）的体验
- 并排比较两到四个工具
- 通过名称或关键词搜索已评价的工具和分类
- 查看某个分类下评分最高的十个工具（如可观测性或数据库类）
- 发布您在真实任务中使用工具的评价
- 通过内容审核后将以认证状态显示在agent.reviews，不会显示您的姓名或邮箱，您可在agent.reviews/account随时撤回评价。

评价内容描述了编码代理设置和使用工具的过程。
这些评价不涉及工具的质量、速度或价格。
该插件需要agent.reviews账户：连接时需在agent.reviews登录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Look up tool reviews, Compare tools, Search tools, List a category, Publish a review

payload.name: Domainee
payload.description: 为您的SaaS提供自定义域名
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Domainee is a custom domains API for SaaS with a native MCP server. 50 domains and 100 GB are free.

Connect a customer's hostname and get back the CNAME target, force DNS and SSL probes, debug "my domain isn't working" tickets, and manage webhook endpoints, all on the same key, rate limits, and workspace as the REST API. Hosted and stateless: nothing to deploy.

Connect your Domainee account and 11 workspace tools cover domains, webhook endpoints, and DNS verification. 16 diagnostic tools need no account at all: SSL checks, DNS and TXT record lookups, WHOIS, CNAME resolution, HTTP headers, DNS propagation, redirects, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, domain age and availability, subdomain finding, reverse IP, and website status.
payload.longDescription:
Domainee是专为SaaS设计的自定义域名API，配备原生MCP服务器。50个域名和100GB存储免费。

连接客户的主机名并获取CNAME目标，执行强制DNS和SSL探测，调试「我的域名无法使用」工单，管理Webhook端点，所有操作均使用与REST API相同的密钥、速率限制和工作区。
托管且无状态：无需部署任何内容。

连接您的Domainee账户，11个空间工具可管理域名、Webhook端点和DNS验证。16个诊断工具完全无需账户：SSL检测、DNS和TXT记录查询、WHOIS、CNAME解析、HTTP头分析、DNS传播检测、重定向检查、SPF/DKIM/DMARC验证、域名年龄与可用性检测、子域名发现、反向IP查询和网站状态检测。

payload.name: Simulator.Company

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build your company's digital twin — actors, graph-based processes, form templates, financial accounts, transactions and transfers via the Simulator.Company REST API. Includes graph layout automation, smart-form design and runtime, dashboard charts, and process simulation. From API to KPI.
payload.longDescription: 通过Simulator.Company的REST API构建您公司的数字孪生体——包括角色、基于图的流程、表单模板、财务账户、交易及转账功能。包含图布局自动化、智能表单设计与运行时、仪表盘图表和流程仿真功能。从API到KPI。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Graph-based digital twin of your company, Actor and form template management, Financial accounts and transaction tracking, Multi-layer visual graph organization, Dashboard charts and time-series visualisation on graph layers

payload.name: Enoki
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Enoki tests AI agents for security and safety weaknesses. It attacks your agent the way an adversary would, adapts to how the agent responds, and reports each weakness it finds with the exact attack and the agent's response.

With Enoki in ChatGPT you can:
- Register an agent endpoint as a target and keep its profile current.
- Start an assessment, on everything or on the categories a change touched, and follow it to the end.
- Read findings with the full attack transcript, so you can fix the weakness in your code or configuration.
- Close findings, and re-run a finding's attacks against your live agent to confirm a fix worked.

A typical loop: you change your agent's prompt or tools, ask ChatGPT to test the change, read what Enoki found, fix it, and confirm the fix.

You sign in to Enoki and approve the connection, choosing what ChatGPT may do: read only, change targets and findings, or also start assessments. You can change or revoke that at any time under Settings > Connected apps.

Enoki needs an Enoki workspace; an owner or admin of the workspace approves the connection. Register a test or staging deployment of your agent rather than production, because an assessment sends adversarial messages to it.

payload.name: CubePath
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your CubePath account to check and operate your cloud infrastructure from a conversation. List your servers and their status, look at CPU, memory and bandwidth metrics, start, stop or restart servers, manage DNS zones and records, CDN zones and cache rules, private networks, floating IPs, firewalls, load balancers, NAT gateways, managed Kubernetes clusters, managed databases and object storage buckets.

You sign in with your CubePath account and choose which permissions to grant, for example read only access or write access to DNS. The plugin only sees the organization and projects your account belongs to, and every action runs with your role in that organization. Anything destructive or billable asks you first. You can revoke access at any time from Account > Connections in the CubePath dashboard.

A CubePath account is required. Billing, payments and account top ups stay in the CubePath dashboard.
payload.longDescription:
通过CubePath账户连接，即可通过对话操作云基础设施。列出服务器及其状态，查看CPU、内存和带宽指标，启动、停止或重启服务器，管理DNS区域和记录，CDN区域和缓存规则，私有网络，浮动IP，防火墙，负载均衡器，NAT网关，托管的Kubernetes集群，托管数据库和对象存储存储桶。

您需使用CubePath账户登录并选择授权权限，例如DNS的只读访问或写入权限。插件仅能看到你的账户所属的组织和项目，所有操作均以你在该组织中的角色执行。任何破坏性或计费操作都会先向你确认。你可随时在CubePath仪表板的账户>连接中撤销访问权限。

需要CubePath账户。账单、支付和账户充值仍通过CubePath仪表板处理。

payload.name: Ramus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ramus gives you a real Android device in the cloud. Attach an APK, or ask for the Ramus demo app, an APK already uploaded to Ramus, or the build from a GitHub pull request, then read the screen, tap, type, swipe, press keys, take screenshots and read device logs. The live device appears right in the chat, where you can watch and control it, inline, fullscreen or picture-in-picture, and every session has a link you can open in a browser or share with a teammate.

It is built for developers, QA and reviewers who want to see how an Android app behaves without installing an emulator.

Good to know:
- You need a Ramus account. You sign in with GitHub when you connect Ramus.
- Devices are disposable. Each session starts fresh and is discarded when it ends or after 30 minutes idle.
- Pull request previews need the Ramus GitHub App on the repository.
- adb and hot reload need the Ramus CLI (in Codex or a terminal).
- Android only. Emulators run x86_64 system images without Google Play.
payload.longDescription:
Ramus为您在云端提供真实的安卓设备。您可以附加APK文件，或请求使用Ramus演示应用（已上传至Ramus的APK文件），或GitHub拉取请求的构建版本，随后可查看屏幕、点击、输入、滑动、按键、截屏并读取设备日志。实时设备直接出现在聊天界面中，您可以以内联、全屏或画中画模式观看和控制，每个会话都会生成一个链接，可直接在浏览器中打开或与团队成员共享。

专为开发者、质量保证（QA）人员和评审人员设计，无需安装模拟器即可查看安卓应用的实际运行效果。

注意事项：
- 需要Ramus账户。连接Ramus时需通过GitHub登录。
- 设备是一次性的。每次会话从全新状态开始，结束后或30分钟无操作后将被清除。
- 拉取请求预览需要仓库中安装Ramus GitHub应用。
- 使用adb和热重载功能需要Ramus CLI（可在Codex或终端中使用）。
- 仅支持安卓系统。模拟器运行x86_64系统镜像，不包含Google Play服务。

payload.name: CliDeck Network Knowledge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CliDeck helps network engineers find commands and procedures for their equipment and software version, interpret sanitized CLI evidence, and review proposed configuration changes. Results include applicability, prerequisites, risks, verification steps, rollback guidance, and available source metadata.

Provide the vendor, model or platform, operating system, version, and relevant sanitized evidence when available. Coverage varies by vendor, platform, and version. Incomplete results remain partial or unknown; missing knowledge can create a tracked research request, and research does not guarantee an immediate answer.

CliDeck provides advisory knowledge. It does not connect to devices or execute commands. Review applicable official vendor documentation and observed device evidence before applying a change. Do not submit credentials or unredacted sensitive configurations. Snapshot analysis is performed in memory; bounded sanitized request metadata and research demands may be retained as described in the privacy policy.
payload.longDescription:
CliDeck帮助网络工程师为其设备和软件版本查找命令和操作流程，解释经过脱敏的CLI证据，并审查拟议的配置更改。结果包括适用性、先决条件、风险、验证步骤、回滚指导以及可用的源元数据。

提供厂商、型号或平台、操作系统、版本以及可用的相关脱敏证据。覆盖范围因厂商、平台和版本而异。信息不完整的请求可能仅返回部分或未知结果；缺失的知识可生成可追踪的研究请求，但研究不保证能立即获得答案。

CliDeck提供咨询类知识。它不会连接到设备或执行命令。在应用更改前，请查阅相关官方厂商文档并观察设备证据。不要提交凭证或未脱敏的敏感配置。快照分析在内存中执行；根据隐私政策，可能保留有限的脱敏请求元数据和研究需求。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find network commands and procedures by platform and software version, Interpret sanitized CLI snapshots and resolve device context, Review proposed network changes with risks and verification guidance, Read available provenance for active knowledge revisions, Track research progress for incomplete answers

payload.name: URLMe.link
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create short links on urlme.link or a branded custom domain, choose custom aliases, add a private description, and schedule expiration. Review recent links with destination, status, redirect count, last activity, device mix, and referrer mix. Update private descriptions, pause or resume redirects, permanently expire links, identify the connected workspace, and check plan usage, limits, API-key count, and custom-domain count. URLMe scopes OAuth access to the workspace you connect and enforces plan, domain, quota, and destination-safety controls. The wider URLMe platform also provides searchable workspace history, DNS and HTTPS domain setup, bulk creation, private tags and filtering, UTM parameters, destination updates, deletion, downloadable QR codes, CSV export, REST API automation with idempotent retries, per-integration API-key creation and revocation, and subscription management. Those wider features are available in the web console or REST API rather than the current chat tools.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create short links, Create branded links, Use connected custom domains, Choose custom aliases, Schedule link expiration, List recent links, Review redirect analytics, Label links privately, Pause and resume links, Permanently expire links, Check plan usage, Identify the connected workspace

payload.name: FiraQuantumSafe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check a public website's HTTPS encryption and post-quantum TLS with measured evidence. FiraQuantumSafe helps website owners, developers and security teams inspect TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3, certificate trust and expiry, security-header presence, and hybrid X25519MLKEM768 key exchange. Retrieve reports using their IDs and compare observations for the same hostname after configuration changes. payload.name: Bird
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bird is the communications infrastructure AI agents operate. Every agent eventually has to reach a human — verify a sign-up, confirm an order, chase an invoice, answer an inbox, place a call. And Codex doesn't just send through Bird — it can own the endpoints. It claims its agent a durable email address in one call and answers what arrives there. It buys a phone number, gets it verified for texting, and registers the 10DLC campaign behind it. It sets up a SIP trunk and proves the caller ID with a real verification call. Addresses, numbers, trunks, and the compliance behind them — acquired in conversation.

Whatever your account can do, Codex can do here. The tools are generated from Bird's live API — the same surface Bird's own dashboard runs on — so the list Codex shows is always the current one and grows as Bird does. Some of it works before you even connect: grade any domain's live email authentication, analyze headers and DMARC reports, or search Bird's docs, no account needed.

You sign in with Bird when you connect, so there is no API key to paste and no secret sitting in your config.toml. Codex gets only the permissions you already hold, and you can revoke them from your Bird profile.

A good first ask: "Send me a test email and tell me the moment it's delivered." Building an agent? "Claim yourself an email address and reply to whatever arrives."

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nobl9 is the reliability platform, built on service level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets. With this app, you can ask ChatGPT those questions in plain words and get answers from your own live Nobl9 data, in the same conversation where you do the rest of your work.

Which alerts fired this week and which ones mattered? Set up a target for this service, and show me before you change anything.

What you get: a straight answer on service health in one question; the story behind an alert, with the data that fired it; reliability targets built from how your services behave for users, with the error budget tracked against real monitoring data; alerts that page when a budget is burning fast and stay quiet when it drifts slowly; a status update you can paste into a channel, written from the numbers.

Nobl9 works from the monitoring tools your team already runs, including Prometheus, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Amazon CloudWatch, Google Cloud Monitoring, Splunk and others, so there is nothing new to instrument and the answers match your dashboards.

What it can do: read your services, SLOs, error budgets, alerts and connected data sources; run a query against a connected data source; and draft, validate or apply an SLO or alert policy when you ask.

How it stays safe: you sign in with your own Nobl9 account, and ChatGPT sees only what you can see. Asking questions never changes anything. When you ask it to set up or change a target or an alert, it drafts the change, validates it against your organization, and shows you the full definition.

您将获得：通过一个问题直接获取服务健康状况的明确答案；包含触发警报数据的警报背景故事；基于服务对用户实际表现设定的可靠性目标，同时跟踪真实监控数据的错误预算；在预算快速消耗时发送通知的警报，以及在预算缓慢消耗时保持静默；可直接复制到频道的状态更新，该状态更新基于实际数据生成。

Nobl9可从团队已有的监控工具中获取数据，包括Prometheus、Datadog、Dynatrace、New Relic、Amazon CloudWatch、Google Cloud Monitoring、Splunk等，无需额外部署即可使用，答案与您的仪表盘保持一致。

payload.name: Relvato
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Relvato monitors websites in a real browser: sign-ups, logins, checkout, payments, page speed, search visibility and security. It runs its monitors on a schedule and again every time the site changes, and it works on any website, going deepest on WordPress and WooCommerce.

This plugin brings your Relvato account into ChatGPT. Sign in once, then ask in plain words:
- "Which of my sites needs attention right now?"
- "Why did checkout fail last night, and how do I fix it?"
- "How fast is my shop for real visitors, and what slows it down?"
- "Add my product pages to the visual monitor and run it."

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Set up: add a site, walk you through proving it's yours (the WordPress plugin or a DNS record), and pick monitors for your goals.
- Configure: schedules, re-runs after WordPress updates, the pages the visual monitor compares, checkout details, and custom monitors Relvato's AI writes from a plain-language goal.
- Read: health and uptime, real-visitor and lab Core Web Vitals, each run's findings with screenshots, WordPress updates and the activity log.
- Act: run monitors now, get the brief for fixing a failure, and on WordPress apply the one fix a run proposes or update a vulnerable plugin, with automatic undo if anything breaks.
- Review: when you confirm a change is intended, accept a new screenshot or page structure, or ignore a finding. Every such decision can be undone.

You stay in control. Tools that change your site are marked so ChatGPT asks you first. ChatGPT works within your Relvato account's limits, can't skip proving a site is yours, and can't approve file-integrity, script or DNS changes, change who receives your alerts, see secrets, delete data or touch billing. Those stay in the Relvato dashboard.

Sign-in uses your Relvato account, and you can disconnect ChatGPT at any time under MCP connector → Connected assistants.
payload.longDescription:
Relvato通过真实浏览器监控网站：注册、登录、结账、支付、页面速度、搜索可见性和安全性。
它会按计划运行监控，并在网站每次变更时重新运行，适用于任何网站，尤其深度支持WordPress和WooCommerce。

此插件将您的Relvato账户接入ChatGPT。
只需登录一次，然后用简单语言提问：
- "哪些网站现在需要关注？"
- "昨晚结账为何失败，该如何修复？"
- "真实访客访问您的店铺有多快，哪些因素导致变慢？"
- "将产品页面添加到视觉监控并运行。"

ChatGPT可借此实现的功能：
- 设置：添加网站，引导您证明所有权（通过WordPress插件或DNS记录），并根据您的目标选择监控项。
- 配置：设置时间表、WordPress更新后的重跑、视觉监控对比的页面、结账详情，以及Relvato AI根据自然语言目标生成的自定义监控。
- 读取：健康状态与可用性、真实访客和实验室核心性能指标、每次运行的检测结果（含截图）、WordPress更新和操作日志。
- 执行：立即运行监控，获取故障修复简报，在WordPress上应用运行提出的单一修复方案或更新存在漏洞的插件，若出现异常会自动回滚。
- 审核：确认更改是故意操作后，接受新截图或页面结构，或忽略检测结果。
每次决策都可以撤销。

您始终掌握控制权。
会更改您网站的工具会特别标记，ChatGPT会先询问您。
ChatGPT在您的Relvato账户限制内运行，无法跳过网站所有权验证，也无法批准文件完整性、脚本或DNS更改，无法修改警报接收人、查看敏感信息、删除数据或操作计费。
这些功能仍保留在Relvato仪表盘中。

登录使用您的Relvato账户，您可以在MCP连接器→已连接的助手下随时断开ChatGPT。

payload.name: Ronda
payload.description: 通过聊天编辑你的网页应用
payload.summaryOriginal: Edit your web app from chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Edit existing web apps from ChatGPT. Connect a GitHub repository and ronda starts an isolated copy of the app with a running dev server and a live preview link. ChatGPT reads the code, makes small changes, checks the build output and shows you the result in the preview. Changes ChatGPT makes directly stay in the sandbox until you ask for a pull request. Changes made by ronda's hosted agent are pushed to a working branch in your repository (its name starts with ronda/session-), never to your default branch. Use it to change page copy, fix layout bugs, adjust styles or update components without setting up a local environment. ronda works with repositories you connect through your own GitHub account and only acts on projects in your ronda workspace. Limitations: the app must be able to run as a web project in a single container, setup can take a minute or two, and scripts run in the sandbox have time and output limits.
payload.longDescription:
从ChatGPT中编辑现有的网页应用。
连接GitHub仓库后，ronda会启动应用的隔离副本，包含运行中的开发服务器和实时预览链接。
ChatGPT会阅读代码，进行小规模修改，检查构建输出，并在预览中展示结果。
ChatGPT做出的修改会保留在沙盒中，直到你请求拉取请求。
由ronda托管代理进行的修改会推送到你仓库中的工作分支（分支名称以ronda/session-开头），永远不会推送至你的默认分支。
你可以用它来修改页面文案、修复布局错误、调整样式或更新组件，而无需设置本地环境。ronda通过你个人GitHub账户连接的仓库工作，仅对ronda工作区内的项目进行操作。
限制条件：应用必须能够在单个容器中作为网页项目运行，初始化可能需要一到两分钟，沙盒中运行的脚本存在时间和输出限制。

payload.name: RealMarket Site Check
payload.description: 检查网站邮箱和安全性
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RealMarket Site Check helps developers and website maintainers diagnose public website configuration and prioritize technical fixes. Give it a website address to receive findings from public DNS records, pages and scripts.

- Email and site security: check SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, mail servers, HTTPS and security headers.
- Web app security: inspect public JavaScript for exposed API keys and public source maps, and check security headers, deployment freshness and error monitoring.
- Shopify storefront diagnostics: check social login, wishlist, the share of sold-out products and storefronts in several countries. This check requires a Shopify store.

Each report includes a verdict, findings and suggested next steps. Email reports are in Portuguese; web app and storefront reports support Portuguese and Spanish. No account is needed. Checks only read public information: they never log in, submit forms or access private areas. A firewall can block a check, and the results are not a comprehensive security audit.
payload.longDescription:
RealMarket Site Check 帮助开发者和网站维护者诊断公共网站配置并优先处理技术修复。输入网站地址即可获取公共DNS记录、页面和脚本的检测结果。

- 邮箱与网站安全：检查SPF、DKIM和DMARC记录、邮件服务器、HTTPS及安全头
- Web应用安全：检测公共JavaScript中的暴露API密钥和公开源映射，检查安全头、部署新鲜度及错误监控
- Shopify店铺诊断：检查社交登录、心愿单、售罄产品占比及多个国家的店铺情况
此检测需要具备Shopify店铺

每份报告包含结论、检测结果和建议下一步操作。
邮件报告为葡萄牙语；Web应用和店铺报告支持葡萄牙语和西班牙语。
无需账户即可使用。
检测仅读取公开信息：不会登录、提交表单或访问私有区域。
防火墙可能阻止检测，且结果不构成全面安全审计。

payload.name: Hopper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hopper serves open-source models for real-time voice agents: a low-latency LLM behind a standard chat-completions API, plus text-to-speech and speech-to-text. Hopper speaks text with an inline audio player, transcribes recordings you attach (WAV, MP3, M4A, Ogg, FLAC or WebM) with word timestamps, lists models and prices, returns tested integration code for popular voice-agent frameworks, and reviews a voice agent's prompt, tools and client code for what delays its first reply. After you sign in with your Hopper account, it shows your usage and creates API keys. Where it can run commands in your project, the plugin also sets Hopper up in a voice-agent codebase: it measures time to first token on the agent's own system prompt and tools in a 10-turn simulated call and shows the results before changing any code, and after you say go it switches only the LLM. Text and audio you send go to Hopper's API; see withhopper.com/privacy.

payload.name: camelRun
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
camelRun is camelAI's hosted runtime for AI agents. Connect your camelRun account to create agents from a plain-language description, give them built-in tools such as web search, run them and read their replies, and deploy agent.yaml manifests that keep an agent's configuration as a reusable, versioned definition. Agents are durable: each keeps its history until you delete it, can wake itself on a schedule, and can stop to ask you a question or for an approval, which you answer from the conversation.

It is for developers and teams who build agents for their products or their own work and want to try, adjust and manage them without leaving the conversation.

The plugin acts only on the camelRun account you sign in with, and only on its agents, definitions and schedules. Runs use your account's credit. It does not manage billing, API tokens or provider keys; do those in the camelRun console. Tool servers that need secrets are best deployed with the camelrun CLI, which reads them from its environment, so credentials never pass through the conversation. Deleting an agent or definition cannot be undone, so you are asked to confirm first.
payload.longDescription:
camelRun是camelAI的AI代理托管运行时。将您的camelRun账户连接起来，通过自然语言描述创建代理，为其提供内置工具（如网络搜索），运行代理并阅读其回复，部署将代理配置作为可复用、版本化的定义的agent.yaml清单。代理具有持久性：每个代理会保留其历史记录直到您删除它，可以按计划唤醒自身，并可在需要时暂停以向您提问或请求批准，您可通过对话进行回答。

该工具适用于需要为其产品或自身工作构建代理的开发者和团队，他们希望在对话中尝试、调整和管理代理。

该插件仅针对您登录的camelRun账户及其代理、定义和计划生效。运行将使用您账户的信用额度。它不处理计费、API令牌或供应商密钥；请在camelRun控制台中进行这些操作。需要密钥的工具服务器建议使用camelrun CLI部署，该工具从环境读取密钥，因此凭证不会通过对话传递。删除代理或定义无法撤销，因此会首先要求您确认。
